text_block_list.text:
We've done the utmost we can domestically.
All that's left is to wait for word from the patron, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Mailbox?! Ah, I'm really not good
with PCs, irons, and that kind of stuff."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hey, please! Someone take a look!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
Honestly. You can't take care of
yourself at all, can you...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: Three missed calls.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Three of them?! And what about the contents?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: The subject line is—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
"Are you free right now?"
"Your account has been suspended."
"We're the cheapest shop around."

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Yikes, they all kind of look like
advertisements or scams."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, Trainer...
choice_data_list: The road ahead... looks pretty rough.
The road ahead... looks pretty rough, huh.

text_block_list.text:
Reality was harsh. Naturally,
it wasn't going to be that easy to gather supporters.

"A high-stakes gamble on a sliver of hope in the Japan Cup.
And yet, the door to the treasure still..."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text: Tap... No emails at all, but, um... you know!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
We've got visitors coming.
A whole bunch around the base.
Rushing outside with Tap Dance City, we saw...
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City!
Great race out there!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't have enough money, I can at least donate some!
Not that I can give a whole lot, though."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like a new fan.
Yeah, looks like a new fan.

text_block_list.text: There is no sign yet that the hearts of the world's wealthiest have been moved. Even so...

The hearts of the people who watched that race were unmistakably moved.
Moved enough that they actually came to see her in person.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, if you need activity funds, y'know...
Why not try crowdfunding or something~?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What? What's a "crowdfun"?

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean that crowdfunding thing
that's all the rage lately?
In other words...
choice_data_list: It means raising funds from supporters.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Funds from supporters...
So basically like mini-sponsors, huh.
choice_data_list: Yeah, and I'll properly repay the favor too.
Yeah, and I'll properly repay you too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so what, a share of the spoils?
Or maybe a blown kiss?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Crowdfunding...
Didn't know that was a thing...

"All that hard work brought an unexpected breeze of fortune.
Even if we can't find a major sponsor..."

If a large number of small-time fans gather together,
we might just reach it.

—To the threshold of the world.
And eventually—to the eternal castle.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right, good, good! Thanks for coming, everyone!
If you've taken a liking to me, nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still! Just taking your money
feels really uncomfortable to me.
If you're going out of your way to invest—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Join us!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Huh... Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I'd be fine with just making a donation, but...
Do we really have to go that far?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course! That's a given.
Once you let your guard down and trust each other, you're already comrades!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Dream with me!
A dream of taking the world into our hands!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Tap Dance City...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Wah... I've fallen in love with it even more...!
I take a quick look around. About a dozen fans have gathered around our base.

With this many passionate supporters,
if we expand things even further—
choice_data_list: You've got this, Tap! This is it!
You can do it, Tap! This is it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Do we have a winning chance, Navigator?
choice_data_list: Yeah, if we properly turn it into a business!
Yeah, if we turn it into a proper business!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text: "We'll help out! Is there anything we can do?"

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Should we make flyers too? Maybe do some touting somewhere?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm counting on you for various things.
Yeah, I'm counting on you for a lot of things.

text_block_list.text:
And so, I took direct command
and decided to reorganize our lineup.

"Creating membership cards," "publishing newsletters,"
and furthermore...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, Smile! Cheese!
Make sure you capture the most emotional moment!

And a bonus "Bromide Photo Shoot."
Just like that, the backbone to support their activities was firmly established.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer... how many people are there!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How many friends have joined to support our activities!?
50 people!? 100 people!?
The total number of companions gathered was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
500!? Whoa, hey...
With that much support behind me...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We've got this!
We can do anything!
The world isn't out of reach!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: This time for sure... This time for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We did it, we did it, guys!!
Now we can finally aim for the castle!!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Tap!!

Hope expands all at once. The future opens wide.
Though the course had momentarily seemed closed—

Tap Dance City forged a path forward in an unexpected way—
through the support of countless fans.
